description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' for the frontend of a notes management application. It manages user authentication state, displays user information if logged in, and provides login/logout buttons styled with Tailwind CSS and inline styles. It also uses Next.js routing for navigation.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by removing user data from local storage, updating state, and redirecting to the login page.
